title: Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) Credit Balance and Refund Terms
content:
The refund terms of the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) are the same for every patient class.

| Term | Figure |
|---|---|
| Smallest credit balance that is refunded (smaller credits are held on the patient's profile) | 1.00 USD |
| Calendar days after a credit balance arises within which the refund is issued | 30 |
| Calendar days since a card payment within which a refund goes back to the original card | 180 |
| Credit applied first to the same patient's other patient-due encounters, oldest service start date first, before any refund | yes |

## Refund method by source payment

| Source payment | Refund method |
|---|---|
| Card payment no more than 180 days old | back to the original card |
| Card payment older than that | paper check |
| ACH bank draft | ACH credit |
| Check | paper check |

## Illustration (hypothetical credits)

A credit of 0.99 is below the 1.00 refund minimum and stays on the profile; a credit of 1.00 is refundable once any offset against the patient's other patient-due accounts has been applied.
